blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday said the Chinese government would provide $20 million to support cooperation efforts in the Asia-Pacific region. In his opening statement at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting here, Xi reaffirmed China’s support for Apec member economies as they convened for the annual forum. “I hereby announce that China will provide 20 million US dollars to support Apec’s practical cooperation,” he said in Mandarin, as translated into English.
